Based on my search, **Lucas Adams** currently plays Noah Newman on *The Young and the Restless*. He made his debut in the role on **November 4, 2024**.

Adams is best known for his previous role as Tripp Dalton on *Days of Our Lives* (2017–2024), where he earned two Daytime Emmy nominations. This isn't his first appearance on Y&R—he actually had a brief one-episode speaking role back in March 2012 as a character named Wesley.

Noah Newman is the son of Sharon and Nick Newman, a legacy character who has been played by numerous actors over the years. The role was most recently portrayed by **Rory Gibson** from 2021 to 2023 (before Gibson moved to *General Hospital* as Michael Corinthos), and prior to that by **Robert Adamson** (2012–2018, 2020) and **Luke Kleintank** (2010–2011), among others.
